# RAJ - Swiss Premium Apple Accessories

> RAJ is a Swiss consumer electronics brand based in Thurgau, Switzerland. We design premium accessories for the Apple ecosystem — wireless charging and iPhone cases — combining Swiss precision with modern aesthetics. Tagline: "Power. Always There."

## RAJ NEXUS 3-in-1 Wireless Charger

The RAJ NEXUS is a premium 3-in-1 wireless charging station that simultaneously charges an iPhone, Apple Watch, and AirPods with a single cable.

### Key Specifications
- **Certification:** Qi2.2 and CE certified
- **iPhone Charging:** Up to 25W fast wireless charging via MagSafe-compatible magnetic alignment
- **Apple Watch Charging:** 5W dedicated charging puck
- **AirPods Charging:** 5W Qi wireless charging pad
- **Design:** Foldable, adjustable angle (0–75°), compact form factor
- **Materials:** Premium aluminium frame (CNC-machined), soft-touch silicone surfaces, non-slip base
- **Compatibility:** iPhone 12–18 series (incl. iPhone 18, 18 Pro, 18 Pro Max), Apple Watch Series 1–10/SE/Ultra, AirPods Pro/3/4 with wireless charging case
- **Full Charge Time:** iPhone to 100% in approximately 1.5 hours (up to 3.3x faster than standard Qi 5W)
- **StandBy Support:** Yes, supports iOS StandBy mode
- **Warranty:** 3-year warranty
- **Safety:** Overheating and overcharge protection

### Pricing and Availability
- **Early Access Price:** CHF 99 (Founder Edition, limited to 100 units, individually serial-numbered #001–#100)
- **Regular Price:** CHF 129 (post-launch)
- **Currency:** Swiss Francs (CHF)
- **Market:** Switzerland
- **Where to Buy:** https://raj.ch/nexus (direct-to-consumer)
- **Payment Methods:** TWINT, Apple Pay, and standard card payments

## RAJ MATRIX Carbon iPhone Case (kaufbar)

Premium iPhone case with a Carbon-Finish for iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. Slim, grippy, MagSafe-compatible, precise fit.

### Key Points
- **Für:** iPhone 17 Pro, iPhone 17 Pro Max, iPhone 18 Pro und iPhone 18 Pro Max
- **Look:** Carbon-Finish, goldene Aluminium-Knöpfe
- **Finishes:** Cherry Carbon und Onyx Carbon
- **Price:** CHF 59
- **Bundle:** iPhone case + MATRIX AirPods case: CHF 79
- **Two Cases:** Two MATRIX iPhone cases: CHF 99
- **MagSafe:** kompatibel — kabelloses Laden ohne Abnehmen der Hülle
- **Passform:** präziser Sitz, erhöhter Rand für Display- und Kameraschutz
- **Marke:** Schweizer Marke, Schweizer Support
- **Status:** Verfügbar / kaufbar
- **Where to Buy:** https://raj.ch/matrix
- **Market:** Switzerland
- **Currency:** CHF

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is RAJ NEXUS compatible with iPhone 18?**
Yes. RAJ NEXUS is fully compatible with iPhone 12–18 series including all Pro and Pro Max models.

**What is Qi2.2?**
Qi2.2 is the latest wireless charging standard from the Wireless Power Consortium (WPC). It offers improved thermal management and up to 25W charging for compatible devices.

**Does the MATRIX case work with MagSafe and wireless charging?**
Yes. The MATRIX carbon case is MagSafe-compatible, so you can charge wirelessly (e.g. on the RAJ NEXUS) without removing the case.

**Is this a Swiss product?**
RAJ is a Swiss brand based in Thurgau. Support, communication and fulfilment are handled in Switzerland, in German.

**Is there a warranty?**
Yes, RAJ NEXUS comes with a 3-year warranty.

## About RAJ

RAJ GmbH is a Swiss consumer electronics brand founded in 2026 in Weinfelden, Thurgau. RAJ brings premium accessories for the Apple ecosystem to Switzerland, built on Swiss precision, sustainable quality, and uncompromising design. Core brand values: Präzision (Precision), Beständigkeit (Durability), Charakter (Character).
